title: Recommend it!
body: I’m enjoying this app so far, more so in regard to its interface rather than the growing plant aspect. I wish there would be an implementation of hiding the completed tasks and habits from the view after their completion day, or perhaps adding an archive of the completed tasks.
author: Annah671
